panels.title: Running Requests
panels.description: Requests currently in the batch (prefill or decode).

panels.title: Waiting Requests
panels.description: Requests queued because the batch or the KV cache is full. Sustained > 0 means the server is saturated.
Share of KV-cache blocks in use. Near 100% the scheduler starts queueing and preempting requests.
panels.title: KV Cache Usage
Generation tok/s (total)
panels.description: Wall-clock generated tokens per second summed over ALL concurrent requests. Not comparable 1:1 with llama.cpp's per-processing-time figure.

panels.title: Per-request tok/s
panels.description: Decode speed one user sees: 1 / mean time-per-output-token of requests that finished in the window. Updates when requests complete.

panels.title: Throughput
panels.description: Aggregate wall-clock throughput across all concurrent requests. Idle samples are filtered (> 0) so the legend mean covers active periods only.

panels.title: Running vs Waiting
panels.description: Concurrency actually achieved vs requests left in the queue.

panels.title: Waiting by Reason
panels.description: Why queued requests are waiting (as reported by vLLM).

panels.title: Preemptions / min
panels.description: Requests evicted from the batch because the KV cache ran out. Non-zero means concurrency exceeds what the cache holds; lower max-num-seqs or context.

panels.title: Queue Time
panels.description: Time a request waited before being scheduled.

panels.title: Tokens per Engine Step
panels.description: Average tokens processed per scheduler iteration: how well the batch is being filled.

panels.title: Finished Requests / min
panels.description: Completed requests per minute, split by finish reason (a large 'length' share means requests hit max_tokens).

panels.title: Time to First Token
panels.description: Queue + prefill. Rises first when concurrency or prompt size grows.

panels.title: Inter-token Latency
panels.description: Gap between successive output chunks for a request. With speculative decoding one chunk can hold several tokens.

panels.title: End-to-end Request Latency
panels.description: Full request duration.

panels.title: Prefix Cache Hit % (range)
panels.description: Share of prompt tokens served from the prefix cache over the selected time range.

panels.title: Prompt Tokens by Source
panels.description: Prompt tokens computed vs reused from cache.

panels.title: Speculative Acceptance %
panels.description: Accepted / proposed draft tokens since the server started.

panels.title: Mean Acceptance Length
panels.description: Tokens emitted per target-model step (accepted drafts + 1 bonus token) since the server started.

panels.title: Acceptance % by Draft Position
panels.description: How often the k-th draft token is accepted. A steep drop after position 1-2 means fewer speculative tokens would do.
